Two stepped attic crowns rise over the SE side (x 10-250 and 500-670) and a small pointed dormer between.

The NW end wall (ring edge 0, 12 m): the 2024 crop at 23 m and 35 deg shows the new brick block next door standing in front of most of it; only the front's west corner pier is legible. Nothing notable to model; the 3DBAG wall is drawn with the brick and band colour.
